When_Needed: When adding co-founder or starting with partner
Key_Clauses: Roles + Responsibilities|Equity Split + Vesting (4yr/1yr cliff)|IP Assignment|Decision Making|Termination|Non-Compete
Risk_If_Missing: Co-founder disputes = #1 startup killer. Without agreement you have zero legal standing.
Giantiny_Note: NEVER start without this. Even married couples.

When_Needed: Before public launch — required for any product users interact with
Key_Clauses: Acceptable Use|Limitation of Liability|Intellectual Property|Termination|Dispute Resolution|Governing Law
Risk_If_Missing: Users can sue without limitation if no ToS. You have no grounds to remove abusive users.
Giantiny_Note: Termly generates in 30 min. No excuse to launch without.

When_Needed: Before collecting ANY user data — required by GDPR/CCPA
Key_Clauses: What Data Collected|How Used|Third-Party Sharing|User Rights (GDPR)|Cookies|Data Retention|Contact Info
Risk_If_Missing: GDPR fines up to €20M. CCPA fines up to $7500/violation. Non-negotiable.
Giantiny_Note: If you use Stripe analytics PostHog — you collect data. You need this.

When_Needed: When hiring any freelancer or contractor
Key_Clauses: Scope of Work|Payment Terms|IP Assignment (critical!)|Confidentiality|Termination|Independent Contractor Status
Risk_If_Missing: Contractor owns the IP they create UNLESS you have IP assignment clause. Critical.
Giantiny_Note: Always include IP assignment. Always. Or the code they write isn't yours.

When_Needed: Before sharing proprietary info with potential partners or contractors
Key_Clauses: Definition of Confidential Info|Exclusions|Duration (2-5 years)|Return of Materials|Remedies
Risk_If_Missing: Without NDA your business plans can be shared freely. Mostly protective not restrictive.
Giantiny_Note: Don't NDA everyone. Use for: investors contractors potential partners. Not for customers.

Key_Clauses: Service Description|SLA (uptime guarantee)|Data Handling|Payment Terms|Auto-Renewal|Termination|Liability Cap
Risk_If_Missing: B2B customers expect formal agreements. Without one you can't sell to enterprises.
Giantiny_Note: Only needed for B2B. B2C usually covered by Terms of Service.

When_Needed: If using cookies or third-party trackers (analytics ads pixels)
Key_Clauses: What Cookies Used|Purpose|Duration|How to Opt-Out|Third-Party Cookies|Consent Mechanism
Risk_If_Missing: GDPR requires explicit cookie consent for EU visitors. €10M+ fine potential.
Giantiny_Note: If you use PostHog Google Analytics Stripe — you use cookies. Add consent banner.

When_Needed: When anyone (co-founder contractor employee) creates IP for the company
Key_Clauses: All Work Product Assigned|Moral Rights Waiver|Prior Inventions Excluded|Representations
DIY_Template: Included in Founders Agreement and Contractor Agreement
Risk_If_Missing: Without this the creator legally owns what they built. Even employees in some jurisdictions.
Giantiny_Note: Include in EVERY agreement with anyone who touches code or design.

When_Needed: When processing personal data for business customers (B2B GDPR)
Key_Clauses: Data Categories|Processing Purpose|Security Measures|Sub-processors|Breach Notification|Data Deletion
Risk_If_Missing: Required by GDPR when you are a data processor. Enterprise customers will ask for this.
Giantiny_Note: Only needed for B2B with EU customers. B2C covered by Privacy Policy.

Risk_If_Missing: Without formal offer letter employment terms are ambiguous. Legal risk.
Giantiny_Note: Include IP assignment and non-compete in every offer letter. Consult lawyer for equity grants.
